threat_event: Ransomware spreads through the BAACS and stops building supervision at many properties and hotels at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy vendor remote tools with shared accounts at 47 sites; 150 unsegmented sites; site supervisors on unsupported software
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G5 BAACS; SYS-G3 WAN; sites in all divisions
regulatory_driver: C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R05 (CPG 2.0 goal 1.E; 3.F; 3.I; 3.O); C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R04 (Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on central components; gateway for most integrator sessions; immutable backup of the central supervisor
treatment_plan: Remove legacy remote tools; segment remaining sites; back up every site program; OT monitoring at critical sites; cross-division ransomware tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Compromise of the BTI integrator tools gives an attacker programs, drawings, and credentials for every group building and many client buildings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-D5 in a legacy account outside the landing zone; local administrator accounts; standing technician credentials; intercompany agreement without security terms
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D5 BTI tools; SYS-G5 BAACS; client buildings
existing_controls: MFA on the BTI directory; EDR on BTI laptops
treatment_plan: Move SYS-D5 into the landing zone; move OT credentials to the group vault; security terms in the intercompany agreement; quarterly access certification of technicians

threat_event: The group cannot restore building supervision at scale after a destructive incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No standby central supervisor; about 40% of site programs only in SYS-D5; multi-site restore never tested; manual procedures at some sites only
existing_controls: Immutable central backups; field controllers run locally
treatment_plan: Back up all site programs to the vault; standby supervisor in provider B; manual operating procedures at every site; multi-site restore exercise

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, investor, tenant, owner, or DoD notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix not exercised across divisions; lease, owner, and DoD clocks differ
regulatory_driver: C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R04 (Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106); State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); N23-R03 (252.204-7012(c))
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: AI and biometric features are deployed in buildings, hotels, and hiring without governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI Standard not applied to vendor-enabled features; no approved-features list for platforms
regulatory_driver: C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R03 (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7120-7124); State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
existing_controls: Group AI Standard (2026-03); Group AI council
treatment_plan: Apply the Group AI program to all use cases; vendor feature change gate; re-tier and condition the High use cases (P10)

threat_event: Badge holder records and face templates are exposed from the access control platform
threat_source: Attacker using a stolen administrator credential; vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 40 enterprise-wide administrators; bulk export not alerted until 2026; face templates held by the vendor
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G5 access control and video platform
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); C-COMMERCIAL-FACILITIES-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a))
existing_controls: MFA for administrators; vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
treatment_plan: Reduce enterprise administrators to 6; alert on bulk exports; contractual breach notice from the vendor within 72 hours
owner: Commercial Property director of security operations

threat_event: Phishing-resistant MFA is bypassed and an administrator identity is taken over across shared services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing; legacy protocols at acquired properties
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM; risk-based sign-in
treatment_plan: Extend phishing-resistant MFA to RBOC operators and BTI technicians; block legacy protocols

threat_event: A critical SaaS provider (access control platform, PMS, property management, project delivery) suffers an outage or breach that affects several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single platform per function; vendor assurance reviewed yearly only
existing_controls: SOC 2 reviews; contracts with notice clauses (most)
treatment_plan: Continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors; exit and degraded-mode plans per vendor

threat_event: An attack on site OT goes undetected because site logs and traffic are not monitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT sensors at 38 of 264 sites; site supervisor and door controller logs not in the SIEM
existing_controls: Central supervisor logs in the SIEM; gateway recordings
treatment_plan: OT sensors at all critical-occupancy sites; forward site logs; OT detection use cases

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts rent refunds, subcontractor payments, or hotel vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High payment volume across three divisions; vendor bank changes requested by email
existing_controls: Call-back verification and dual approval for bank changes
treatment_plan: Extend call-back verification to tenant refunds; payment anomaly monitoring

threat_event: SEC disclosures about cybersecurity are late or do not match practice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Item 106 text drafted before the OT gaps were known; materiality factors for building incidents not defined
treatment_plan: Building-incident materiality factors; Item 106 text reviewed against P01 and P07

threat_event: Common control inheritance is assumed where it does not exist (BTI tools, hotel building OT)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance not documented for SYS-D5 or hotel OT
treatment_plan: Document inheritance for SYS-D5 and hotel OT; annual confirmation

threat_event: A major hurricane affects headquarters, the RBOC, and many Florida properties and hotels at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RBOC and secondary console room both at headquarters; coastal hotels
existing_controls: Cloud-hosted supervisor; cellular failover; hurricane plans
treatment_plan: Secondary RBOC console outside Florida; remote operator access through the gateway

threat_event: The group is not ready for its first CCPA cybersecurity audit report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Audit scope and auditor independence not yet planned
treatment_plan: Scope the audit period starting 2027-01-01; select an independent auditor

threat_event: Covered video surveillance or telecommunications equipment is found in group buildings, putting federal contract eligibility at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy cameras in acquired buildings; affiliate brands hard to recognize
treatment_plan: Portfolio-wide camera inventory against the covered-entity list; replace any found

threat_event: Staff or contractors misuse video surveillance to track tenants, guests, or co-workers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad video access at security consoles and guard contractor remote viewing
treatment_plan: Quarterly video access review; alerts on bulk exports
owner: Commercial Property director of security operations

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes BAACS or division data
treatment_plan: Bring the legacy account into the landing zone (with GR-02)

threat_event: Pending rules (CIRCIA final rule, the next PCI DSS version, the CMMC Phase 2 suspension) change obligations faster than the program adapts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No single owner tracks rule changes across divisions
treatment_plan: Quarterly regulatory watch to the board risk committee
